name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
keywords: farmer income support direct benefit transfer kisan samman nidhi land holding
summary: Income support of Rs 6,000 per year to landholding farmer families, paid directly to the bank account.
summary_hi: भूमिधारक किसान परिवारों को सीधे बैंक खाते में प्रति वर्ष ₹6,000 की आय सहायता।
benefits: Rs 6,000 per year in three equal instalments of Rs 2,000 through Direct Benefit Transfer.
eligibility_text: Small and marginal farmer families who own cultivable land. Not eligible: institutional landholders, income-tax payers, serving or retired government employees (except multi-tasking staff) and holders of constitutional posts.
how_to_apply: Register online at the PM-KISAN portal (Farmers Corner > New Farmer Registration) or visit a Common Service Centre (CSC) or your local agriculture office. Complete e-KYC after registration.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
ministry: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
keywords: health insurance hospital treatment cashless ayushman card senior citizen 70 vay vandana
summary: Cashless hospital treatment cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year at empanelled hospitals.
summary_hi: सूचीबद्ध अस्पतालों में प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का कैशलेस इलाज।
benefits: Health cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation. Senior citizens aged 70+ can also get cover under the Vay Vandana extension.
eligibility_text: Families identified through SECC deprivation and occupational criteria (state lists vary). Citizens aged 70 years and above are covered irrespective of income under the Ayushman Vay Vandana extension.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility on the PM-JAY portal or 'Am I Eligible' tool using your mobile number or ration card, then get your Ayushman card made at an empanelled hospital, CSC or via the Ayushman app.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G)
keywords: rural house housing pucca kutcha awas home construction assistance
summary: Financial assistance to build a pucca house for rural households that are houseless or live in kutcha houses.
summary_hi: बेघर या कच्चे मकान में रहने वाले ग्रामीण परिवारों को पक्का घर बनाने के लिए आर्थिक सहायता।
benefits: Financial assistance for a pucca house of minimum 25 sq m with a toilet; additional support for toilets under Swachh Bharat Mission and 90/95 days of MGNREGA wages for construction labour.
eligibility_text: Rural households that are houseless or live in kutcha / dilapidated houses and are identified through SECC / Awaas+ data and verified by the Gram Sabha.

eligibility_pathways.label: Rural household without a pucca house

how_to_apply: Selection is from the SECC/Awaas+ list verified by the Gram Sabha. Contact your Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office to check your name and complete registration through the Awaas App.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban (PMAY-U 2.0)
keywords: urban house housing home loan subsidy EWS LIG MIG interest subvention awas
summary: Housing support and home-loan interest subsidy for urban EWS, LIG and MIG families without a pucca house.
summary_hi: पक्का मकान न रखने वाले शहरी EWS, LIG और MIG परिवारों को आवास सहायता और होम लोन ब्याज सब्सिडी।
benefits: Central assistance for house construction/purchase and interest subsidy on home loans, depending on the vertical and income group.
eligibility_text: Urban families in EWS (income up to Rs 3 lakh), LIG (Rs 3-6 lakh) or MIG (Rs 6-9 lakh) groups who do not own a pucca house anywhere in India.

eligibility_pathways.label: Urban household without a pucca house

how_to_apply: Apply online at the PMAY-Urban portal or through your Urban Local Body, a Primary Lending Institution (bank / housing finance company) or a CSC.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
keywords: girl child daughter savings account education marriage beti bachao small savings
summary: High-interest small savings account for the future education and marriage expenses of a girl child.
summary_hi: बालिका की भविष्य की शिक्षा और विवाह खर्च के लिए उच्च ब्याज वाली लघु बचत योजना।
benefits: Government-notified interest rate (reviewed every quarter) with tax benefits; deposits from Rs 250 up to Rs 1.5 lakh per financial year.
eligibility_text: Account can be opened by a parent or legal guardian in the name of a girl child below 10 years of age. Only one account per girl child, maximum two girls per family (with exceptions for twins/triplets).
how_to_apply: Visit any post office or authorised bank branch with the application form and documents, and make the minimum initial deposit.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
keywords: lpg gas connection cylinder cooking women bpl free connection
summary: Free LPG connection for adult women from poor households that do not already have one.
summary_hi: एलपीजी कनेक्शन न रखने वाले गरीब परिवारों की वयस्क महिलाओं को मुफ़्त एलपीजी कनेक्शन।
benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection with financial support from the government; EMI facility for the first refill and stove.
eligibility_text: Adult woman (18+) belonging to a BPL / poor household with no LPG connection in the household. KYC with Aadhaar and bank account required.

eligibility_pathways.label: Adult woman in a poor household

how_to_apply: Submit the KYC application form at the nearest LPG distributor or apply on the PMUY portal.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
keywords: pension retirement unorganised sector old age monthly pension contribution
summary: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 after age 60 for people who save regularly from age 18-40.
summary_hi: 18-40 वर्ष की आयु में नियमित बचत करने वालों को 60 वर्ष के बाद ₹1,000 से ₹5,000 मासिक पेंशन की गारंटी।
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs 1,000-5,000 from age 60 depending on the contribution; spouse and nominee benefits.
eligibility_text: Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 with a savings bank account. Income-tax payers are not eligible to join.
how_to_apply: Visit your bank branch or use net/mobile banking to enrol and set up auto-debit of the monthly contribution.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
keywords: life insurance low premium death cover bank account jan suraksha
summary: Low-cost life insurance cover of Rs 2 lakh for bank account holders aged 18-50.
summary_hi: 18-50 वर्ष के बैंक खाताधारकों के लिए ₹2 लाख का कम प्रीमियम वाला जीवन बीमा।
benefits: Rs 2 lakh life cover on death due to any reason; renewable yearly with auto-debit of a small annual premium.
eligibility_text: Bank account holders aged 18 to 50 who give consent for auto-debit of the premium. Cover continues up to age 55.
how_to_apply: Enrol at your bank branch, through net banking or at a CSC; give auto-debit consent.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
keywords: accident insurance disability cover low premium bank account jan suraksha
summary: Accidental death and disability insurance of up to Rs 2 lakh for bank account holders aged 18-70.
summary_hi: 18-70 वर्ष के बैंक खाताधारकों के लिए दुर्घटना में मृत्यु/विकलांगता पर ₹2 लाख तक का बीमा।
benefits: Rs 2 lakh for accidental death or total disability and Rs 1 lakh for partial disability, for a very small annual premium.
eligibility_text: Bank account holders aged 18 to 70 who give auto-debit consent.
how_to_apply: Enrol at your bank branch, via net banking or at a CSC; give auto-debit consent.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
keywords: business loan collateral free micro enterprise shishu kishore tarun self employed shop startup
summary: Collateral-free loans for non-farm micro and small businesses under Shishu, Kishore and Tarun categories.
summary_hi: गैर-कृषि सूक्ष्म और लघु व्यवसायों के लिए शिशु, किशोर और तरुण श्रेणियों में बिना गारंटी ऋण।
benefits: Collateral-free loans: Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishore (Rs 50,000 to 5 lakh) and Tarun (Rs 5 to 10 lakh); higher limits may apply under Tarun Plus.
eligibility_text: Indian citizens aged 18+ who run or plan to start a non-farm income-generating business in manufacturing, trading or services, with a credit need up to the scheme limit.
how_to_apply: Apply at any bank, NBFC or micro-finance institution, or through the Udyamimitra portal, with a simple business plan.

name: Stand-Up India
keywords: women entrepreneur SC ST business loan greenfield enterprise manufacturing services trading startup
summary: Bank loans of Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs setting up a new enterprise.
summary_hi: नया उद्यम शुरू करने वाले SC/ST और महिला उद्यमियों के लिए ₹10 लाख से ₹1 करोड़ तक का बैंक ऋण।
benefits: Composite bank loan between Rs 10 lakh and Rs 1 crore for a greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services, trading or allied agriculture activities.
eligibility_text: SC/ST and/or women entrepreneurs above 18 years setting up a first-time (greenfield) enterprise. Non-individual enterprises need at least 51% holding by an SC/ST or woman entrepreneur.
how_to_apply: Apply through the Stand-Up Mitra portal, any scheduled commercial bank branch or the Lead District Manager.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
keywords: street vendor hawker loan working capital rehdi thela cart digital payments cashback
summary: Collateral-free working-capital loans for street vendors, with higher loans on timely repayment.
summary_hi: रेहड़ी-पटरी विक्रेताओं के लिए बिना गारंटी कार्यशील पूंजी ऋण, समय पर चुकाने पर अधिक राशि।
benefits: Working-capital loan in increasing tranches (initial Rs 10,000, then higher amounts on repayment), interest subsidy and cashback incentives for digital transactions.
eligibility_text: Street vendors vending in urban areas on or before the cut-off date, with a Certificate of Vending / ID card or Letter of Recommendation from the Urban Local Body.
how_to_apply: Apply on the PM SVANidhi portal or via a CSC / lending institution; the Urban Local Body verifies vendor status.

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
keywords: artisan craftsperson traditional trades toolkit training stipend carpenter potter blacksmith tailor loan
summary: Recognition, skill training, toolkit support and cheap credit for traditional artisans and craftspeople.
summary_hi: पारंपरिक कारीगरों और शिल्पकारों के लिए पहचान, कौशल प्रशिक्षण, टूलकिट सहायता और सस्ता ऋण।
benefits: PM Vishwakarma certificate and ID card, skill training with daily stipend, toolkit incentive, and collateral-free credit at a concessional interest rate, plus digital-transaction incentives.
eligibility_text: Artisans and craftspeople aged 18+ working with their hands in one of the listed traditional trades, who are not in government service and have not taken a similar credit-linked scheme loan recently.
how_to_apply: Register at a Common Service Centre or on the PM Vishwakarma portal; verification is done by the Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body and District Implementation Committee.

name: MGNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act)
keywords: rural employment 100 days wage work job card unskilled manual labour village
summary: Guarantee of up to 100 days of paid unskilled manual work per year for rural households.
summary_hi: ग्रामीण परिवारों को प्रति वर्ष 100 दिन तक अकुशल शारीरिक कार्य का वेतनयुक्त रोज़गार।
benefits: Up to 100 days of wage employment per rural household per financial year at the notified state wage rate; unemployment allowance if work is not provided within 15 days.
eligibility_text: Adult members (18+) of rural households who are willing to do unskilled manual work. Register with the Gram Panchayat to get a job card.

eligibility_pathways.label: Adult member of a rural household

how_to_apply: Apply for a job card at your Gram Panchayat, then submit a written or oral application for work.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना
keywords: old age pension senior citizen bpl elderly monthly pension social assistance
summary: Monthly pension for elderly people from BPL households aged 60 and above.
summary_hi: 60 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के बीपीएल परिवारों के बुजुर्गों के लिए मासिक पेंशन।
benefits: Monthly central pension for those aged 60-79 and a higher amount for 80+, usually topped up by the state government; paid via bank / post office account.
eligibility_text: Applicant must be 60 years or older and belong to a Below Poverty Line household as per state-specified criteria.
how_to_apply: Apply at the Gram Panchayat / Block office / Urban Local Body or the state social welfare department portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
keywords: pregnant women maternity benefit cash incentive lactating mother nutrition first child anganwadi
summary: Cash maternity benefit to pregnant and lactating women to compensate for wage loss and support nutrition.
summary_hi: गर्भवती और स्तनपान कराने वाली माताओं को मज़दूरी हानि की भरपाई और पोषण के लिए नकद मातृत्व लाभ।
benefits: Cash incentive paid in instalments directly to the bank account after pregnancy registration, antenatal check-up and child registration/vaccination.
eligibility_text: Pregnant women and lactating mothers aged 19+ for the first living child (the scheme may also support a second girl child). Women in regular government or PSU jobs are excluded.
how_to_apply: Register at your Anganwadi centre or approved health facility, or apply online on the PMMVY / Poshan Tracker portal.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
name_hi: अनुसूचित जाति विद्यार्थियों के लिए पोस्ट मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
keywords: scholarship SC student fees maintenance allowance college university national scholarship portal
summary: Scholarship covering fees and maintenance allowance for SC students studying after Class 10.
summary_hi: कक्षा 10 के बाद पढ़ रहे अनुसूचित जाति विद्यार्थियों के लिए फीस और रखरखाव भत्ते की छात्रवृत्ति।
benefits: Reimbursement of compulsory fees and a monthly maintenance allowance depending on the course type.
eligibility_text: Scheduled Caste students studying at post-matriculation level (Class 11 onwards) in recognised institutions, whose parents' annual income is up to Rs 2.5 lakh.
how_to_apply: Register and apply every year on the National Scholarship Portal; the institute and state nodal officer verify the application.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
keywords: crop insurance farmer drought flood hailstorm yield loss premium kharif rabi
summary: Low-premium crop insurance protecting farmers against crop loss from natural calamities, pests and diseases.
summary_hi: प्राकृतिक आपदा, कीट और रोग से फसल नुकसान पर किसानों को कम प्रीमियम में बीमा सुरक्षा।
benefits: Insurance cover and claim payment for notified crops; farmers pay a small fixed premium share (about 2% for kharif, 1.5% for rabi food crops, 5% for commercial/horticulture crops) with the rest subsidised.
eligibility_text: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, including sharecroppers and tenant farmers.
how_to_apply: Enrol before the cut-off date for the season through your bank, CSC, insurance agent or the PMFBY portal / Crop Insurance app.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / NABARD
keywords: farmer credit loan short term crop cultivation low interest animal husbandry fisheries
summary: Flexible short-term farm credit at concessional interest for cultivation, allied activities and working capital.
summary_hi: खेती, संबद्ध गतिविधियों और कार्यशील पूंजी के लिए रियायती ब्याज पर लचीला अल्पकालिक कृषि ऋण।
benefits: Revolving credit limit for farm inputs with interest subvention for timely repayment; accident insurance cover is usually included.
eligibility_text: Farmers (owner cultivators, tenant farmers, sharecroppers) and people in allied activities such as animal husbandry and fisheries.
how_to_apply: Apply at your bank branch (commercial, cooperative or regional rural bank) or through the PM-KISAN portal's KCC facility if you are a PM-KISAN beneficiary.
